expr: (() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const panelTitles = ['Queue waiting','Queue active','Queue failed','Task lifecycle rate','Model calls by provider','Tokens by kind','Model spend (USD)','Model latency p95','Plugin tool calls','HTTP requests by status','Schedule runs by outcome','Supervisor events'].filter(x => t.includes(x)); return { path: location.pathname, panelTitlesFound: panelTitles.length, panelTitles, noData: t.includes('No data'), hasNumeric: /[0-9]/.test(t) }; })()
